Description
If you are considering investing because of its excellent store of value or to diversify your asset, Bullion Trading LLC brings an exciting opportunity for investors to invest in a versatile and popular silver product. The 3 oz Valcambi Silver Skyline CombiBar (3 x 1 oz) .999 Fine Silver | With Assay Card is now available at Bullion Trading LLC at low premiums.
Manufactured by the Valcambi Mint with over 50 years of background in producing high-quality and innovative products, the 3 oz Valcambi Silver Skyline CombiBar (3 x 1 oz) .999 Fine Silver | With Assay Card also delivers this promise. 3 oz Valcambi Silver Skyline CombiBar (3 x 1 oz) .999 Fine Silver | With Assay Card are designed with pre-cut lines so that they can be separated perfectly into 3 bars weighing 1 Troy oz each. Each bar features the Valcambi stamp, weight, and purity of the metal. Investors prefer this Valcambi Silver Combibar because of its unique design and the flexibility to break them into smaller size bars to sell or trade them individually.
Design of 3 oz Valcambi Silver Skyline CombiBar (3 x 1 oz) .999 Fine Silver | With Assay Card
The 3 oz Valcambi Suisse Silver Skyline CombiBar is one of the most versatile and distinctive silver bullion products available anywhere in the world. Containing 3 full troy ounces of .999 fine silver, this ingeniously engineered bar can be cleanly separated by hand into 3 individual 1 oz silver bars along precision pre-scored lines — without any loss of silver content or purity.
Produced by Valcambi Suisse of Balerna, Switzerland, the inventor and patent-holder of CombiBar divisible bar technology, this product delivers the cost efficiency of buying silver in a 3 oz format with the added flexibility of fractional ownership. Whether you choose to keep the bar intact as a 3 oz silver investment or break off individual 1 oz segments to give as gifts, trade, or liquidate separately, the choice is entirely yours.
The Skyline Series is Valcambi’s premium artistic CombiBar line, featuring a stunning skyscraper cityscape design across the bar’s face — elevating this beyond a standard bullion bar into a genuinely collectible silver piece. Each bar in this series is sealed in a blister pack with an assay card confirming the silver content and .999 fine purity.
Every one of the 3 individual 1 oz segments shares a unique alphanumeric serial number, traceable back to the original bar — providing complete authenticity and provenance for each piece, even after separation.
This CombiBar is slim enough to fit in a wallet, purse, or safe deposit box envelope, making it one of the most portable and practical forms of silver ownership available.
Main Highlights of 3 oz Valcambi Silver Skyline CombiBar (3 x 1 oz) .999 Fine Silver | With Assay Card
Contains .999 fine silver for 3 Troy oz of silver bar
Produced by Valcambi Mint
Packaged in a protective plastic along with an assay card for authenticity
Set of 3 silver bars, each weighing 1 Troy oz
Observe featuring a stunning skyscraper cityscape design with the weight and purity of silver
The Reserve of the bar featuring a stunning skyscraper with “Valcambi Suisse” emblazoned on the side.
